attchmntText: Health X Platform Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Health X Platform Limited submitted the audio recording of the earnings conference call for the second quarter of the fiscal year 2026-27. The call was hosted on 16th November 2026 at 4.00 PM IST. Senior management discussed performance for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The audio file is available on the company website at https://healthxplatform.com/Audio/HXPL_Q2_FY27_Conference_Call.mp3. This disclosure is pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The submission was made to BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited. The notice was signed by Pratap Singh, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Health X Platform Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of Unaudited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026
voiceSummary: Health X Platform Limited filed a notice regarding the newspaper publication of its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. The results were published in Business Standard and Ek Din on 16th November, 2026. The filing was made by Company Secretary Pratap Singh in compliance with Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The document also contains an unrelated tender notice from the Executive Engineer of Berhampore Division PWD for civil works in Murshidabad.

attchmntText: Health X Platform Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Health X Platform Limited filed an investor presentation with BSE and NSE on 14th November 2026 under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations. The company reported revenue from operations of Rs. 489.1 crores for Q2 FY27, up 58.8% year-on-year from Rs. 307.9 crores. Gross margin stood at 8.3%, an increase of 80 basis points compared to the same period last year. Operating expenses as a percentage of revenue decreased to 10.8% from 12.4% in Q2 FY26. The company posted a loss after tax of Rs. 12.7 crores for the quarter. Net working capital days were recorded at 23 days. The presentation highlighted the launch of RetailAir, a mobile-first billing SaaS platform. It also noted the transition to 100% ownership of the SastaSundar platform following the end of the partnership with Flipkart.

attchmntText: Health X Platform Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Health X Platform Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 14, 2026. The standalone net loss after tax was 31.85 lakhs for the quarter and 83.28 lakhs for the half year. Basic loss per share was 0.10 rupees for the quarter and 0.26 rupees for the half year. Total assets stood at 27,025.77 lakhs as of September 30, 2026. The company is pursuing a Composite Scheme of Arrangement and Amalgamation involving Microsec Resources Private Limited, Innogrow Technologies Limited, and Sastasundar Healthbuddy Limited. This scheme is subject to requisite approvals and has not yet been accounted for in the financial results. Expenses of 14.75 lakhs related to the scheme were incurred in the previous quarter. The statutory auditor issued a clean limited review report on the financial statements.
